t: Prysmian meter tails three-pack provides complete supply and earthing connectivity for consumer unit installations. This pack contains two 1m grey-sheathed live tails and one 1m green/yellow-sheathed earth tail, each featuring 16mm² stranded copper conductors rated 300/500V. The rigid PVC insulation with brown, blue and green/yellow colour-coded cores ensures safe installation at the consumer unit, whilst the compact 1m length and robust 7-strand construction deliver reliable performance for domestic electrical supply terminations.
